# CrystalWeb Digital Agency

> CrystalWeb is a full-service digital agency run by Habeeb Falade, specializing in ecommerce website development, digital marketing, and growth services for businesses looking to launch, redesign, or scale their online presence.

CrystalWeb helps ecommerce brands build and grow online stores. The agency covers the full stack a business needs to sell online: website development, ecommerce platform setup, digital marketing, Google services, paid advertising, SEO, and graphic design — delivered by one team rather than coordinating multiple freelancers.

## Services

- **Website**: WordPress development, Wix website design, niche/custom websites, Webflow development, website migration between platforms, landing page design
- **Ecommerce**: Shopify store setup, Etsy store setup, eBay store management, Amazon storefront setup, BigCommerce development, product research
- **Digital Marketing**: Social media marketing, email marketing, influencer marketing, content marketing, TikTok marketing, TikTok Shop setup
- **Google Service**: GA4 (Google Analytics 4) setup, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Google My Business, Google Merchant Center
- **Paid Ads**: Facebook Ads, Instagram Shopping & Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads
- **SEO**: SEO, SEM, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), backlinking & link building, keyword research
- **Graphics**: Logo & brand identity, social media graphics, ad creatives & banners, product mockups, print & packaging design

## Track record

- 285+ happy clients, 760+ projects delivered
- Top Rated on Upwork with a 4.9/5 rating across 36 reviews and 100% Job Success Score
- Based in Nigeria, works with clients globally (remote-first, all communication via WhatsApp, email, and video calls)

## Pricing and engagement

CrystalWeb takes on both fixed-scope projects and ongoing retainers. Projects typically start with a free consultation to scope the work. A deposit can be paid directly on the website (card, bank transfer, USSD, PayPal, or USDC) to reserve a project slot; the balance is agreed after the initial discussion.
